title: Your servers
intro: Signed in as {name}. Pick a server to manage. Access is checked again on every page.
empty: There is no server you can manage with Mewvo yet.
limited: Only the first {count} servers are checked and shown.
refreshText: Mewvo keeps your server list for up to 30 days (never your Discord login token). Refresh it to see all your servers.
addIntro: Servers you manage where Mewvo is not added yet.
fromBotText: You opened the dashboard with your website login, so this list shows only servers that have Mewvo and where you are a member. Refresh it from Discord to see all your servers, also the ones where you can add Mewvo.
logoutAllHint: “Log out on all devices” ends every dashboard login of your Discord account, this one too.
